notes: Exact source images; aliases use the resolved physical animation files.
Rows are preserved source direction indices; runtime direction mapping must be explicit.
Attack, Shoot and SpAttack are animation labels, not named moves, projectiles, damage or capture mechanics.
Anchor coordinates are frame-local pixels; red/blue names preserve channels because tool documentation differs on handedness.
Head falls back to body when no black marker exists. Missing anchors remain null; do not invent them.
